symbols.name: CacheRootQuotaState
symbols.summary: Holds conservative store-wide quota attribution and prepared-publication counters persisted in the root control ledger.

symbols.name: Validate(string)
symbols.summary: Rejects identity mismatches, impossible quota counters and bounded catalog or operation counts outside the format contract.

symbols.name: Reserve(long)
symbols.summary: Returns a state charging additional positive reserved bytes, or rejects capacity before attribution changes.

symbols.name: Release(long)
symbols.summary: Returns a state releasing at most the bytes currently reserved; inconsistent releases report Corruption.

symbols.name: Apply(CacheQuotaChange, long)
symbols.summary: Releases the supplied reservation and applies one checked quota delta, rejecting overflow or exceeded store limits.

syntax.content: public CacheRootQuotaState Apply(CacheQuotaChange change, long releasedCredit)

symbols.name: Prepare(CacheQuotaChange)
symbols.summary: Charges prepared entry and operation counters before publication without yet adopting the final quota delta.

symbols.name: Confirm(CacheQuotaChange, long)
symbols.summary: Removes the prepared counters and applies the publication delta while returning its reserved credit exactly once.

syntax.content: public CacheRootQuotaState Confirm(CacheQuotaChange change, long releasedCredit)

symbols.name: AbortPrepared(CacheQuotaChange, long)
symbols.summary: Removes prepared counters and returns reserved space for a publication proven not to have committed.

syntax.content: public CacheRootQuotaState AbortPrepared(CacheQuotaChange change, long releasedCredit)

symbols.name: Snapshot(long)
symbols.summary: Maps conservative attribution to public quota fields, separating actual control bytes from unused dedicated workspace.

symbols.name: Remaining(long, ReadOnlySpan)
symbols.summary: Subtracts nonnegative bounded components without overflow, returning negative one for inconsistent attribution.

syntax.content: public static long Remaining(long maximum, ReadOnlySpan parts)

symbols.name: Add(long, long)
symbols.summary: Adds a checked quota delta without allowing negative counters or integer overflow.

syntax.content: public static long Add(long current, long delta)
public static bool operator !=(CacheRootQuotaState? left, CacheRootQuotaState? right)
public static bool operator ==(CacheRootQuotaState? left, CacheRootQuotaState? right)

symbols.name: Format
symbols.summary: Gets the durable quota-record format, currently one.

symbols.name: StoreId
symbols.summary: Gets the generated store identity owning this root quota state.

symbols.name: MaximumBytes
symbols.summary: Gets the fixed maximum physical byte attribution admitted by this quota.

symbols.name: MaximumEntries
symbols.summary: Gets the maximum total current and prepared entry count admitted by this quota.

symbols.name: CurrentBytes
symbols.summary: Gets bytes attributed to current published payloads.

symbols.name: RetiredBytes
symbols.summary: Gets bytes attributed to retired payloads still awaiting safe physical reclamation.

symbols.name: ReservedBytes
symbols.summary: Gets bytes durably admitted to physical operations whose final attribution is not yet confirmed.

symbols.name: MetadataBytes
symbols.summary: Gets conservative bytes attributed to checked metadata and index publications.

symbols.name: CurrentEntries
symbols.summary: Gets the count of currently published positive and negative entries.

symbols.name: WorkspaceBytes
symbols.summary: Gets the dedicated control-ledger workspace charged before ordinary data admission.

symbols.name: PreparedEntries
symbols.summary: Gets positive entry-count deltas reserved by publications awaiting exact confirmation.

symbols.name: PreparedOperations
symbols.summary: Gets the count of prepared publications whose final quota deltas remain unresolved.

symbols.name: CatalogContracts
symbols.summary: Gets the retained contract count bounded by the format limit of 1,024.

symbols.name: OperationRecords
symbols.summary: Gets the retained tracked-operation count bounded by the configured history limit.

symbols.name: Available
symbols.summary: Gets remaining unreserved bytes after current, retired, metadata and dedicated control-workspace attribution, or a negative value for inconsistent counters.
